If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% for early horizon.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% downward bias for late horizon.
